Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J28/J28nB219.xml). Recorded Sayings of Monk Zhuanyuheng of Purple Bamboo Grove. Zhuanyu Guanheng owns the retained deployment, remembering that the frightened child called on Avalokitesvara before anyone taught him.

Senses.Explanation: The fixed sutra negative for all a being fails to register, from moving worlds to its own mind-buddha. Yongming Yanshou, quoting the Tiantai commentary in his Mirror, leaves the dragons and asuras unaware of entering the pore; Dahui Zonggao warns that the dust-laden mind, unaware and unknowing, sins for an instant and drops into the unrelieved depths; the Bloodline Treatise in the Bodhidharma attribution lays the blame squarely: the buddha has no fault, beings inverted and unaware call anything but their own mind the buddha; and Zhuanyu Guanheng remembers that as a frightened child he would, unaware and unknowing, call on Avalokitesvara before anyone taught him. Shishuang Chuyuan's staff swallows the sands-of-Ganges buddhas and lands at one gulp, their beings unaware, while he demands to know where the patch-robed nose is; Zhongfeng Mingben promises that when feelings shed and dust drains away, the striver breaks through unaware and finds the three men already footloose before birth; Pu'an Yinsu quotes the Garland so that every buddha wakes inside one dust-mote's beings while those beings stay unaware; and Wanru Tongwei's whisk tosses this world into another with its beings never noticing, then sets both worlds back where they always stood.
